description: JSON to CSV converter — Convert JSON to CSV offline: an array of objects, a single object, an object that holds the rows (auto-detected or root=a.b), or NDJSON. Nested objects flatten to dot paths (sep=), arrays join with '; ' (arrays=join|index|json), columns are the union in first-seen order or columns=a,b.c to select and order. RFC 4180 quoting, delimiter=comma|tab|semicolon|pipe, header=false, eol=crlf. Flags CSV/formula-injection cells (= + - @) and neutralizes them with excel_safe=true; reports sparse columns and per-column fill. Up to 5,000 rows. Price: $0.002 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: util_json_to_csv
